dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Hyperglycemia-induced chorea/ballismus (diabetic striatopathy) due to severe uncontrolled diabetes mellitus

ALTERNATIVE 1: Functional neurological movement disorder

ALTERNATIVE 2: Hyperglycemia-associated myoclonus or dyskinesia without radiographic striatal abnormality

ALTERNATIVE 3: Medication- or toxin-induced movement disorder despite an initially negative screen
